_about: Commitments register (PRD FR-5/FR-7). Restrictive obligations AtliQ has already signed, extracted from data/raw/signed_contracts and checked clause-by-clause against the source text. Quotes are verbatim (grounding-checked by scripts/check-data.ts). Status is computed from 'end' vs DATASET_TODAY unless status_override is set; expired items stay visible, labelled Expired. 'matcher' tells the review engine how to test an incoming contract for a potential collision. verified_by_human is set by the reviewer on the /register page.
generated_by: Initial extraction assisted by AI and cross-checked against evals/expected_register.json; regenerate a comparison with `npm run register`.

items.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.

extra_quotes.quote: "Hospitality Business" means any person, firm or entity that owns, operates, manages or franchises hotels, resorts or serviced apartments, or that provides distribution, revenue-management or guest-analytics services to any such person, firm or entity.

services are provided "in the GCC" if the Hospitality Business receiving them is headquartered in, or the services relate to properties or operations located in, any state of the GCC, irrespective of where the services are performed.
The Supplier shall procure that each of its Affiliates complies with this Clause 12 as if it were a party to this Agreement, and any breach by an Affiliate shall be deemed a breach by the Supplier.
"Restricted Period" means the Term and the period of eighteen (18) months following the expiry or termination of this Agreement.

items.scope: No data analytics, AI or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business (hotel owners/operators, or distribution / revenue-management / guest-analytics providers to hotels) headquartered in, or for properties in, the GCC (UAE, KSA, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman).
